shots.focal_element: Two-line headline under a cluster of hand-drawn line-art agent faces
shots.transition_other: video start (first shot, no incoming transition)
shots.typography: Large geometric/grotesque sans (low-confidence guess: Inter), bold weight, sentence case, tight tracking, centred two-line stack in black on off-white.
shots.what_happens: Opens on the Notion logo with a cursor clicking it on an off-white canvas; it gives way to a single illustrated face with line one 'You assign the tasks.', then flanking agent faces (hard hat, headset, etc.) fan out behind it as line two appears; the last frame already shows the blue-framed product window starting to come in.
shots.build_rebuild: On an off-white canvas, swap a centred logo for an SVG avatar plus headline line 1, then stagger 4 overlapping circular avatar badges outward from behind the centre avatar while headline line 2 fades/slides up under line 1.

shots.focal_element: Notion page 'Andy's OS' in a browser window framed on a saturated blue background
shots.typography: Native Notion UI type: bold sans page title and section headings, regular-weight sans list items, sentence case, default tracking.
shots.what_happens: Short establishing view (under 1 s) of a personal Notion workspace page with a to-do list, quick links and an agent avatar button at bottom right, inset as a floating window on a blue backdrop; the cursor rests to the right of the to-do block.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a rounded, soft-shadowed browser-chrome screenshot of the product page at ~93% width centred on a solid brand-blue full-frame background, with a static cursor sprite over it.

shots.focal_element: The To-dos checklist, especially 'Build bug tracking dashboard', with the cursor hovering it
shots.transition_other: detector flagged 'other'; visually a punch-in from the full window to a tight crop of the to-do block
shots.typography: Native Notion UI type shown large: bold sans headings, regular sans list items, sentence case.
shots.what_happens: Camera is zoomed into the to-do list; the cursor moves onto the first item 'Build bug tracking dashboard' and then drifts down toward 'Prep for bugs meeting' while the frame slowly drifts/pulls back slightly, setting up the task the agent will be given.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the same page screenshot to ~2.5x anchored on the to-do block, animate a cursor sprite onto the first checklist item, and ease a slight scale-down over the 1.6 s shot.

shots.focal_element: Notion AI side panel with 'How can I help you today?' and the agent avatar
on_screen_text: How can I help you today?
shots.typography: Notion UI sans: semibold prompt heading, regular menu items, small blue 'New' pill label, light-grey placeholder text; sentence case.
shots.what_happens: Framing pushes to the bottom-right corner where the agent avatar shows a 'Hi, Andy!' greeting bubble; the cursor clicks it and the AI side panel opens with suggestions and an input box; the cursor then moves up to the avatar, revealing a 'Personalize' pill beside it, which gets an outline on hover.
shots.build_rebuild: Push the camera into the bottom-right of the page screenshot, pop a 'Hi, Andy!' tooltip by the avatar, cut the panel open on click, then animate the cursor to the panel avatar and fade in an outlined 'Personalize' chip next to it.

shots.focal_element: The agent avatar being personalised (accessory carousel, name and profile form), then the prompt input
on_screen_text: How can I help you today?
shots.typography: Simplified Notion UI on off-white: small grey sans field labels, regular sans field values and menu items; the prompt is also shown as a giant full-bleed regular-weight sans with a text caret during typing; sentence case.
shots.what_happens: Long multi-phase shot. (1) A horizontal carousel of accessory cards (moustache, duck, pencil, chili, cowboy hat, flower, leaf) scrolls under the avatar; the blue-outlined selected card changes and the accessory appears on the avatar's head until the cowboy hat is chosen. (2) A Name/Profile form appears; 'Lucky' is typed into Name and the Profile dropdown opens to pick 'Bug Wrangler'. (3) The avatar scales up with a 'Howdy, Partner!' speech bubble. (4) Back to the blue-framed AI panel, now with the hatted avatar; the cursor clicks the input and the prompt is typed, shown as an extreme close-up of large text with a caret ('Cr', 'Create a b', 'bug track', 'king dash'), then returns to the panel showing 'Create a bug tracking dashboard.' with the send button active.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a scene sequence: a horizontally sliding row of rounded accessory cards with a blue selection ring whose icon swaps onto a centred SVG avatar, then a two-field form with typed name and an opening dropdown, then an avatar scale-up with a speech-bubble pop, then the panel with a typewriter prompt rendered in a full-frame zoomed text layer before cutting back to the panel with the filled input and blue send button.
